site.sitedescription: Shallow lake with extnsive wetlands. The lake lies in an ice marginal channel west of the St. Charles Moraine. It may be a kettle basin or may have formed by a glacially influenced, pressurized groundwater blowout. Native vegetation was a mosaic of tallgrass prairie and oak groves.
